name: H-496 Falcon

origin.basis: Chaoyang is the bicycle-tire brand of ZC Rubber (Zhongce); sold by the official 朝阳轮胎官方旗舰店 on Tmall.

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory location.

positioning: Folding road tire sold as the upgrade of the Chaoyang Cobra (眼镜蛇) Pro, in black and colour sidewalls.
weight_basis: The official listing gives 248 g without stating the size.

wet_notes.summary: An owner who did not say clincher or tubeless found it stable in the rain.
A commenter who did not say clincher or tubeless found it too slippery for braking in the wet.

community.summary: A creator's two-week power-meter comparison of a Chaoyang tire the post calls the Cobra (眼镜蛇); owners also use that name for this tire, so the exact model is unresolved. Uncontrolled road test: a slower substitute for the GP5000.
A 28C failed along the sidewall casing after about 500 km; the tire had been mounted against its rotation arrow.
A commenter on a budget-tire comparison rated it average overall with acceptable puncture resistance.
Owner: softer and smoother than a Continental Ultra Sport 3, possibly more side grip in the dry, about 1 mm narrower.
Owner: puncture-resistant and durable but heavy (about 280 g), firm and average-rolling, with slight cracking over time; a commenter's new tire leaked through the sidewall edge after 40 km.
A rear lasted about a year and nearly 10,000 km with one flat, then cracked deeply enough to expose the puncture layer.
Front and rear sidewalls cracked after a few hundred road kilometres at 95-100 psi.

availability.note: Sold by Chaoyang's official Tmall store; no European or North American seller verified.

price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01 for the black 28C option; coupon price CNY 178.2. The listing does not say whether an option is one tire or a pair.

caveats: Size-specific weights, casing TPI and pressure limits are not published in the listing.
Owners report sidewall cracking, one casing split after about 500 km and one tire lasting nearly 10,000 km; no owner wet-road report or independent lab test was found.
The official store does not say whether a listed price is for one tire or a pair.
The tubeless version is listed separately as the H-496 Falcon TLR.

image.shown: A new folded 25C Falcon in an owner's post; the sidewall reads CHAO YANG 隼 MERLIN (the Falcon's sidewall name), S-MAXX, DINO SKIN and 120TPI. The TLR version is not shown.
image.alt: Chaoyang H-496 Falcon folding road tire with its MERLIN sidewall label

rights.usage_note: A photo from a public Xiaohongshu post, shown from Xiaohongshu with a link to the original post; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components catalogues and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this model and, where the model is sold in more than one construction, say which; seller replies, questions, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out. Owners who did not say clincher or tubeless are kept as family-level wet notes; an inner tube that burst during fitting is not a tire report.

checks.note: Seven posts; no owner says clincher or tubeless
